validation.actual: Both specifications regenerate exactly. All selected Ghidra instructions match original source. Shared 3,088 records and 66 control artifacts are exact; 33 authored tests and 67 negative cases pass.
validation.tolerance: Exact integer, byte and hash equality over captured object/global storage and specified call relationships. Caller stack locals, uncaptured writes, GTE register side effects and hardware timing are not claimed.

unobserved_source_branches: Different/negative resource selections, alternate platform/model dispatch and resource initialization remain explicit failures.

Original replay uses A0, 15, 13 and 05 on this route. Other source-reconstructed cases, including S3 duration carry, B3, BE, E2 and packed-stack aliasing, have authored fixtures but no original-run claim here.

Facing modes 1/3, other header flags/angles/rates/divisors, nonunit or extra matrix scales, alternate frame formats, allocation and GTE product remain outside the observed domain. Source-only implementations are distinguished from explicit unresolved branches.
limitations: Two captures describe the same input route; shared orientation/replay calls are correlated rather than treated as additional independent executions.
The 512-byte captured sprite view includes pointed and trailing storage; only its source-reviewed fields are named. It is not a complete original structure-size claim.
Resource rebinding/lifetime, ordinary VM side effects, complete frame geometry, renderer/texture/palette behavior and 68 previously recorded field-resource runtime byte changes remain open.
Complete active motion composition, later position/layer/floor/ceiling/rollback, followers/camera/contact, hardware cadence and semantic readiness remain required.
Observed GP 80059170 qualifies the selected original entries, not the entire program. Extra Ghidra exports do not imply complete function reconstruction.
